messages:
Nina (AM): BetaBank POC seeing no trace ids in our structured logs and occasional 429s during their smoke tests. Can SE/infra take a quick look?
Tom - SE: On it. Are they on Hosted? Any client-side proxies?
Nina (AM): Hosted, ap-southeast region. They run an envoy sidecar + corporate reverse proxy.
Jules (Infra): I can check tenant quotas. Quick check shows bursts hitting 250rps, tenant cap is 180 rps -> 429s expected.
Customer: BetaBank: Also, we are sending traceparent header but it never shows up in your logs. Our app logs show only request start/stop.
Tom - SE: Could be header normalization in envoy/proxy. Can you run a direct curl to our gateway bypassing proxies and paste results? Quick repro for them: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "traceparent: 00-11112222333344445555666677778888-0123456789abcdef-01" \
  -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```
Tom - SE: If direct curl yields trace_id in our response logs, header is being stripped by their stack. Common fixes: ensure `proxy_set_header traceparent $http_traceparent;` (nginx) or `add_request_header("traceparent", request.getHeader("traceparent"))` (envoy filter). Some enterprise gateways lowercase headers; set both cases.
Customer: BetaBank: We ran direct curl as suggested and now see trace_id in your logs. So it's our envoy config.
Jules (Infra): For the 429s we can temporarily raise their tenant throttle to 600rps for a 3-hour window to let them run realistic ramp tests. Want me to do that?
Nina (AM): Yes please, schedule it for 30m from now for 3 hours. I'll tell the customer.
Alert Bot: quota-change: beta-bank-poc throttle updated 180 -> 600 rps until 2026-03-20T19:30:00Z by Jules.
Tom - SE: Also sending a short note to the customer about Splunk/Datadog drains: when `traceparent` is present we emit `trace_id` in structured logs. Configure your drain to include `trace_id` as a top-level field so you can correlate easily.
Customer: BetaBank: Thanks, we'll update envoy and re-run. Appreciate the quota bump.
Nina (AM): Action items: 1) Customer updates envoy to forward traceparent (they said they'll do it). 2) Jules applied temporary quota bump. 3) Tom to DM sample drain mapping for Splunk.
Tom - SE: Will post snippets in the ticket. :thumbsup:
Nina (AM): Great, closing this thread for now. Will reopen if they hit anything else. :wave:
